 Print 'Don't Trouble The Trouble'. South Indian cinema has several films from action to comedy, lined up for movie lovers this week. Viewers can explore titles across Malayalam, Tamil, Telugu and Kannada on multiple OTT platforms. Take a look at the upcoming and recently released titles, along with their streaming details. Binge watch and enjoy! 'I'm Game' OTT release
 Dulquer Salmaan's fantasy action film 'I'm Game' is set for its digital premiere after its theatrical release on September 3, 2026. The actor plays Dan John, a wealthy man whose lifestyle revolves around money and the pursuit of excitement. The film presents Dulquer in a distinctive role. Watch Low-Budget South Films Outperform Big Releases, Signaling Major Shift In Box Office Trends JioHotstar will begin streaming the movie on November 6. Audiences can watch it in Malayalam, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu and Kannada. Announcing the digital premiere, the platform shared the following message on social media: "The game is about to begin! Dulquer Salmaan's I'm Game streaming from November 6 on JioHotstar in Malayalam, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu & Kannada." 'Meesaya Murukku 2'
 Hiphop Tamizha Adhi's Tamil musical comedy drama 'Meesaya Murukku 2' is available on SonyLIV. The film features Hiphop Tamizha Adhi in multiple roles, connecting different timelines in the story. Ketika Sharma plays Laila, while Harshath Khan appears as Jeeva's friend Harshath. The supporting cast includes Chaithra J Achar, Ramya Ranganathan, Baba Bhaskar and Karunas. ETimes rated the film three out of five stars. 'Nooru Kodi Vaanavil' makes its digital debut
 Harish Kalyan and Siddhi Idnani headline the Tamil romantic drama 'Nooru Kodi Vaanavil'. Written and directed by Sasi, the film follows a young couple whose relationship faces complications because of family expectations and misunderstandings. After remaining unreleased for several years, the movie is finally reaching digital audiences. ZEE5 is scheduled to premiere it on November 6. 'Immortal'
 GV Prakash Kumar and Kayadu Lohar star in the Tamil romantic horror film 'Immortal', which is available on SonyLIV. Directed by Mariyappan Chinna, the movie follows Magi, a young man searching for affordable accommodation. His search takes him to an apartment shared with Sindhu. However, the unusually low rent soon becomes suspicious. Strange incidents inside the property gradually expose its connection to an ancient supernatural mystery. Magi's seemingly ordinary housing arrangement then develops into an unsettling experience. Kayadu Lohar's film received 2.5 stars out of 5 from ETimes. 'Don't Trouble The Trouble' and 'Sarala Subbarao' on OTT
 Fahadh Faasil headlines the Telugu fantasy comedy 'Don't Trouble The Trouble' as Suri, an orphan working as an ambulance driver. Financial difficulties lead him to consider kidnapping as a way to arrange money. His plan takes an unexpected turn when he encounters Divya, a young girl who claims she made her own parents disappear. Directed by Shashank Yeleti, the film also features Ssara Palekar, Saurabh Sachdeva and Mahesh Manjrekar. It is streaming on Netflix. Meanwhile, Kannada romantic drama 'Sarala Subbarao', starring Ajay Rao and Misha Narang, is available on Amazon Prime Video. Directed by Manju Swaraj K R, the film originally opened in theatres on February 20, 2026, before its digital premiere on October 30. Set in the 1970s, the story follows a couple whose relationship develops during the 1971 Indo-Pak War. Rather than depicting battlefield events, the narrative explores how developments along the border affect ordinary people. Love, family responsibilities and resilience are central to the story. 'Sarala Subbarao' received 2.5 stars out of 5 from ETimes.
